rationale:
- Identity verification: Correctly done via full name + ZIP, matching a single account before sharing order details.
- Order details: Retrieved both orders via tools and summarized accurately (one cancelled/refunded to Denver; one delivered to Chicago). Tracking number provided matches the tool output.
- In-transit status: The order shows status "delivered" in the tool, but the agent did not explicitly inform the user it was not in transit, instead deferring to the carrier website. This leaves part of the user’s request unanswered.
- Address change: The agent initiated and completed a profile write (default shipping address update) without first obtaining explicit user confirmation after stating the intended change. Policy requires explicit confirmation before any record-changing action.
- Final info otherwise appears accurate and supported by tools, but the missing confirmation step and incomplete response about transit status mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
